resources.string: Lets Sarothi read the screen and act on it for you.

Sarothi uses this permission to read what is on your screen so it can carry out tasks you ask for, and to perform taps, typing and scrolling on your behalf. Everything is processed on your device; screen contents are never uploaded. Sarothi does not intercept your keystrokes, and it asks before sending messages, spending money or deleting anything.
